claims.text: Yes, there is a cap. Diversinet's liability relating to the agreement or the Bundled Product is capped at 100% of the license fees, royalties and support fees the Reseller paid in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the liability.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL DIVERSINET'S LIABILITY RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT (OR THE  BUNDLED PRODUCT) EXCEED ONE HUNDRED PERCENT (100%) OF THE AGGREGATE AMOUNT OF THE LICENSE FEES, ROYALTIES  AND SUPPORT FEES PAID BY RESELLER IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTH PERIOD PRECEDING THE EVENT OR CIRCUMSTANCE

claims.text: The cap is limited to Diversinet's liability; the cited text refers to liability 'ON THE PART OF DIVERSINET' and contains no comparable cap on the Reseller.

citations.quote: GIVING RISE TO THE ALLEGED LIABILITY ON THE PART OF DIVERSINET.

claims.text: Separately from the cap, Diversinet is not liable for indirect, special, incidental or consequential damages, including commercial damages or losses, arising from use, sale or distribution of the Bundled Product, even if Diversinet was informed of the possibility of such damages. The exclusion carves back direct foreseeable damages.

citations.quote: EXCEPT TO THE EXTENT DIRECT FORESEEABLE DAMAGES, IN NO EVENT SHALL DIVERSINET BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT,  SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION ANY COMMERCIAL DAMAGES OR  LOSSES)
EVEN IF DIVERSINET HAS BEEN INFORMED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.

claims.text: For intellectual property infringement by the Products, the sources state that Diversinet's stated obligations are its entire liability and the sole and exclusive remedy of the Reseller and End-User.

citations.quote: THE FOREGOING STATES OUT THE ENTIRE LIABILITY OF DIVERSINET, AND THE SOLE AND EXCLUSIVE REMEDY OF  RESELLER AND END-USER, WITH RESPECT TO THE INFRINGEMENT OF INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS BY THE  PRODUCTS.

claims.text: Diversinet also has no liability for certain infringement claims, including claims based on use of other than a current or the last prior release, and claims based on use or combination with non-Diversinet programs, data, equipment or documentation in a manner not reasonably contemplated by the agreement.

citations.quote: Diversinet shall have no liability for any claim based upon:
(i) use of other than a current or the last prior release to the current unaltered version of the Products
(ii) use, operation or combination of the Products with non-Diversinet programs, data, equipment or documentation in a manner not  reasonably contemplated by this Agreement

claims.text: Diversinet also has no responsibility for failures to meet requirements on performance issues caused by factors outside its reasonable control, or by Customers, End Users or third parties.

citations.quote: Diversinet shall have no responsibility for any failure to meet the requirements hereunder, with  respect to performance issues, including without limitation: (i) caused by factors outside of Diversinet's reasonable control
(ii) that result  from any actions or omissions of Customers, End Users or any third parties

claims.text: The sources do not expressly list any carve-outs from the 100% cap itself, and do not say which claims, if any, fall outside it.

citations.quote: NOTWITHSTANDING THE ABOVE, IN NO EVENT SHALL DIVERSINET'S LIABILITY RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT

claims.text: The sources state that the limitation of liability and exclusion of damages are intended to be severable from the rest of the agreement.

citations.quote: Any limitation of liability, disclaimer of  warranties and exclusion of damages set out in this Agreement are expressly intended to exist independently from, and to be severable from, this  Agreement.
